roles.title: Senior Director of Product, Performance - Unannounced Title
roles.location: US - Culver City, United States; US - United States

bullets: Lead and develop the Product Performance team, with accountability for business performance, live operations strategy and execution, product growth, and data-informed iteration
Own revenue forecasting, KPI targets, performance reporting, and executive business reviews in partnership with the Head of Product and General Manager
Set the live operations strategy and oversee execution of the calendar across events, offers, limited-time content, and in-game communications
Define the game’s learning agenda and partner with Analytics, User Research, and other cross-functional partners to prioritize the analyses and research needed to guide decisions
Drive monetization optimization by identifying opportunities, developing hypotheses, and overseeing experimentation and iteration
Be a thought leader in game development, directing F2P systems and live ops around core gameplay in collaboration with game design.
Craft and communicate compelling product narratives that inspire teams and anchor decisions—whether influencing executive stakeholders or aligning pods to core outcomes.
Push innovation forward in a blue ocean design space, connecting us to proven game mechanics, and driving to our USP and F2P viability
Evaluate ideas through the lens of product goals, user value, market opportunity, and creative resonance.
Provide clear, high-quality product feedback, continuously improving design quality while preserving momentum. See where ideas shine, where they falter, and make good tradeoffs…
